name: Cortney’s Handyman Service
address: 2644 Dryer Ave, Largo, FL 33770, United States

reviewSamples.author: Sara Weedin
reviewSamples.text: Corteny has been my handyman for several years now and has done general home repairs for me and also renovated my whole kitchen. He does amazing work and makes sure everything is up to your standards! I highly recommend!

reviewSamples.author: Tony Petrasso
reviewSamples.text: We recently had Cortney come by to fix two water leaks under our bathroom vanity, and he did an absolutely fantastic job. He was professional, humble, and very respectful throughout the entire visit. His pricing was fair, his workmanship...

reviewSamples.author: Hank Valencia
reviewSamples.text: I called lots of big companies and smaller "handyman" people to help me repair a pool pump pvc plumbing pipe I busted. Cortney said he'd come today on his way home from another job and he did everything PERFECTLY and a lot less than others...
